overall_resume: Resume of someone in early years of their career, the resume should only be of one page
Resume of someone with limited work experience, the resume should first have their education history, the certifications they have acquired and the projects they have worked on
Resume should have no errors in grammar and factual information
projects_section: The projects mentioned in the resume should also have the tools that were used in them
The link to the project should be present for their easy access
skills_section: The skills whose certifications are present in the resume should be highlighted
education_section: Education history should have the modules that the applicant has completed rather than the results they achieved in order to not give the assessor a chance to quantify the ability of the candidate
work_experience: The descriptions should be short and to the point. They should quantify the effects of their work
The descriptions should follow the format of 'Did X using Y, resulting in the Z impact'
